*Sanidassanattika, Sanidassanaduka* (Patthana 16.53) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna, the seventh treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Within the intricate structural schema of the Paṭṭhāna, this section treats the conditional relationships arising from the intersection of the *sanidassana* triad (triplet of visible phenomena) and the *sanidassana* dyad (pair of visible phenomena) [SuttaCentral].
